verse.verse_1: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
verse.verse_2: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
verse.verse_3: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
verse.verse_4: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
verse.verse_5: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
verse.verse_6: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
verse.verse_7: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
verse.verse_8: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
verse.verse_9: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
verse.verse_10: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
verse.verse_11: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
verse.verse_12: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
verse.verse_13: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
verse.verse_14: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
verse.verse_15: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
verse.verse_16: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
verse.verse_17: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verse.verse_18: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
verse.verse_19: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
verse.verse_20: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
verse.verse_21: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
verse.verse_22: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verse.verse_24: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
verse.verse_25: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
verse.verse_26: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
verse.verse_27: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
verse.verse_28: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
verse.verse_29: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
verse.verse_30: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
verse.verse_31: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
verse.verse_32: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verse.verse_33: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
verse.verse_34: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
verse.verse_35: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
verse.verse_36: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
verse.verse_37: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
verse.verse_38: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
verse.verse_39: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
verse.verse_40: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
verse.verse_41: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
verse.verse_42: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
verse.verse_43: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
verse.verse_44: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
verse.verse_45: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
verse.verse_46: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
verse.verse_47: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
verse.verse_48: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
verse.verse_49: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
verse.verse_50: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
verse.verse_51: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
verse.verse_52: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
verse.verse_53: And every small and great thing is recorded.
verse.verse_54: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
verse.verse_55: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
